scope.device: 2D n-IGZO R02 teaching compact surrogate for single-bottom-gate and symmetric dual-gate DC current
scope.purpose: Recover from the preserved R01 failure by removing one train-unidentifiable length degree of freedom, then fit the unchanged qualified curves and evaluate the unchanged whole-condition holdout before any simulator cross-check or circuit prediction.
changed_variables_in_future_fit: compact surrogate coefficients except the fixed first-order inverse-length geometry factor
fixed_inputs: qualified persisted T01/T02/T03 CSV bytes and SHA-256 values
parameter bounds and deterministic optimizer settings
R01 split, scoring filters, current floor, weights and every acceptance threshold
300 K nominal trap-free ideal-contact IGZO teaching-model boundary
prohibited_work_before_contract_commit: C00 or any later circuit cell

structure_recovery_contract.trigger: The preserved R01 holdout-gm failure opened a structure audit; its numerical value does not select the R02 equation, coefficient, initial vector, bounds, restart or threshold.

pre_fit_identifiability_basis.source: The committed R01 split contains eight reference-length 10 um training curves and only one non-reference 8 um training curve while the R01 kernel exposes two free length coefficients.
pre_fit_identifiability_basis.diagnosis: One non-reference training condition cannot robustly separate a free amplitude exponent from a free logarithmic threshold shift; the two effects can trade off without changing the frozen training/holdout split.

r02_change.fixed_value_basis: First-order channel geometry normalization in the existing charge-difference teaching kernel; it is a regularizing analytic assumption, not a fit to R01 holdout or a claimed physical scaling law.

unchanged_items: 4 whole-condition holdout curves with 70 scored points
7 zero-VDS invariants and 7 repeated low-VDS audits
all linear, logarithmic, VTH, gm, monotonicity, finite, nonnegative, bound and wall-time gates
deterministic training-only optimizer and no-restart rule
local validity domain and non-calibration evidence boundary
structure_recovery_contract.prohibited_interpretation: R02 is a preregistered structural regularization attempt. It does not reinterpret R01, establish inverse-length physics, use holdout feedback for parameter selection, or guarantee R02 PASS.

dataset_contract.target_current_column: absolute drain current per unit out-of-plane width
rules: Only rows selected from E3 independently checked project numerical tables may be scored.
The split is by complete bias or geometry condition rather than random neighboring points.
Holdout rows cannot initialize parameters enter the objective select a restart or alter thresholds.
Reference meshes reciprocal paths reverse sweeps and repeated control curves are audits rather than independent validation.
VDS=0 rows are zero-current invariants and repeated VDS=0.01 output rows are cross-stage audits rather than weighted duplicates.
External and senior data remain reference_only under G0 and cannot enter fitting or holdout.

split_summary.split_policy: fixed whole-condition split registered before fitting

excluded_physics_variants.reason: interface charge model differs from nominal
bulk trap charge model differs from nominal

audit_and_exclusion_contract.completion_rule: Audit challenge and excluded sets must be listed in the future report but cannot change fit parameters or formal acceptance.

reference_kernel.model_kind: smooth charge-difference DC teaching surrogate with fixed first-order inverse-length geometry normalization
reference_kernel.current_direction_domain: formal M00 scoring uses VDS >= 0 only
reference_kernel.length_geometry_factor: Lref/L with exponent fixed exactly to 1.0 and excluded from optimization
reference_kernel.reciprocity_rule: Top and bottom gate coefficients are identical in the nominal symmetric dual-gate route.

parameter_contract.name: length_vth_slope_v
parameter_contract.role: sole train-fitted local length coefficient: threshold shift per ln(L/Lref)

optimization_contract.per_curve_weighting: Each training curve contributes equal total squared weight; linear and log residual blocks each contribute 0.5 per curve.

report_separately: aggregate equal-curve-weight logarithmic RMSE in decades
holdout VTH proxy absolute error for transfer curves with a valid common criterion
holdout gm proxy relative error at VTH+0.2 V when the common grid brackets it
parameter bound distance and validity domain
forbidden_reporting: one blended score without linear and log components
metrics after removing a failed curve
experimental accuracy uncertainty or confidence interval
physical Ion Ioff mobility DOS contact or temperature parameters

reference_python.role: required M00 fit and independent validation route

ngspice_behavioral.role: generated IGZO-only behavioral translation candidate after M00 PASS; execution deferred to M01

aimspice_level15.role: IGZO-only native NMOS LEVEL=15 candidate plus explicit dual-gate control wrapper; execution and separate error comparison deferred to M01
aimspice_level15.hspice_mapping_note: AIM-Spice LEVEL=15 corresponds to the teacher's HSPICE Level 61 route but the project must not call an unexecuted card HSPICE-validated.

model_routes.m01_gate: Neither simulator route is accepted or circuit-ready until M01 runs the same geometry bias and metrics and reports route differences.

validity_domain.dual_gate_stack: symmetric 30 nm physical Al2O3 per gate with k=6.8
validity_domain.width_scaling: Linear conversion from the 2D per-width current is a teaching assumption and is not a measured width-dependence validation.
excluded: capacitance transient noise or AC behavior
trap contact temperature ferroelectric stress or reliability laws
experimental process corners uncertainty or extrapolation

required_failure_artifacts: exact parameter bounds and initial vector
training and holdout predictions and residuals
prohibited_recovery: change a train or holdout selector after seeing results
remove a curve or point after seeing results
change the current floor or per-curve weights after seeing results
relax a parameter bound or acceptance threshold after seeing results
use holdout data to select a restart or parameter vector
use any R01 holdout metric or fitted coefficient to select the R02 structure fixed exponent initial vector or bounds
overwrite delete or relabel a failed fit
failure_retention.acceptance_change_rule: Any justified contract change requires a new revision with the failed run preserved; the previous run remains FAIL.

evidence_boundary.contract_allowed_claim: An E3 R02 static check may verify that one train-unidentifiable length degree is removed while R01 evidence, dataset bytes, selectors, split, metrics, thresholds, outputs and failure rules remain frozen, without fitting a model or running TCAD SPICE or a circuit.
evidence_boundary.future_m00_pass_allowed_claim: A later R02 two-level PASS may establish an IGZO-only structurally regularized teaching compact surrogate fit to qualified project numerical curves with unchanged condition-held-out numerical errors and an explicit local validity domain.
prohibited_claims: experimental fitting calibration or measured predictive accuracy
physical VTH SS mobility Ion Ioff DOS contact or temperature parameters
independent external validation because train and holdout originate from the same frozen teaching model
AIM-Spice or ngspice validation before M01 execution
equation identity between native AIM-Spice Level 15 and ngspice behavioral routes
physical inverse-length scaling or proof that fixed Lref/L is the true IGZO law
reinterpretation replacement or deletion of the R01 E0/FAIL evidence
circuit-ready active-load model quantitative circuit results layout PEX or HZO evidence
evidence_boundary.next_gate: After this R02 contract passes and is committed, first implement and self-test a revisioned R02 runner and independent checker without formal-data optimization; only after that execution-chain commit may exactly one formal R02 fit run. M01 and all downstream work remain closed until the R02 runner and independent persisted-evidence checks both pass.
